github.copilot.chat.commitMessageGenerat.text: Describe the actual changes in the diff accurately. Do not invent intent, benefits, fixes, testing, or functionality that the diff does not demonstrate.
Use a concise imperative subject, ideally under 72 characters. Be specific about the affected feature or behaviour. Avoid vague subjects such as 'Update files', 'Improve code', or 'Various fixes'.

For simple changes, write only a subject. For complex changes, add a blank line followed by a short body explaining the main changes. Mention the reason only when it is supported by the available context.
Distinguish functional changes from formatting, refactoring, configuration, and content changes. Do not describe a refactor as a bug fix unless the diff supports that.
Use plain English. Do not use emojis, em dashes, promotional language, or claims that tests passed.
